title: It Takes Two Tomorrow, Too
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuya (25) and Rio (28) are an unmarried couple in their second month of living together. In short episodic chapters they share meals, work stress and small daily moments, more than dating but not yet married. The five-volume series is a quiet slice-of-life comedy about domestic life as a couple.
life_message: A good life is found in the small, shared comforts of daily life with someone you love.
